methods.rating: Frozen nominal-stockfish-davidson-v1: normal1500/sd800 prior; 50 most recent rated games; 1320/1800 nominal anchors; full-strength excluded; unknown draw propensity integrated over40 bins
methods.primary: Each run: first floor(R/2) vs last floor(R/2) complete six-game rotations; middle rotation omitted if odd; incomplete trailing rotations omitted. Preserves all opponent/color cells.
methods.test: Two-sided permutation of complete rotation vectors across phase labels; exact where <=200000 allocations, otherwise200000 uniform Monte Carlo draws and plus-one p. Holm across six run-level combined-rated tests.
methods.interval: Phase-specific cluster-bootstrap percentile score-difference intervals. Separate Bayesian rating-difference intervals are conditional on segment rating model; no CI-overlap rule used.
methods.limitations: Exploratory observational audit; permutation assumes exchangeable rotations under null and bootstrap assumes independent rotations within phase. Persistent serial dependence may invalidate those assumptions. No randomized training ablation or generalization test; do not infer causal learning or no learning from p values.
